title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
authors_zh: Juncheng Wu、Hardy Chen、Haoqin Tu、Xianfeng Tang、Freda Shi、Hui Liu、Hanqing Lu、Cihang Xie、Yuyin Zhou
paper_type_zh: 视觉语言模型课程数据发布与 RLVR 构造方案
best_for_zh: 研究多模态 RLVR、重复采样、能力课程、难度课程及 rollout 数据审计的读者
one_line: VLM-CapCurriculum releases 32,736 staged RLVR problems with 16 extracted Qwen3-VL-8B answers, per-answer correctness flags, and a pass rate per row, enabling capability-first and within-stage difficulty curricula without releasing the underlying full reasoning completions.
VLM-CapCurriculum 发布 32,736 条仅含 train split 的分阶段 RLVR 题目；每条保留 16 个抽取答案、逐答案正确性和 pass_rate，但不发布原始 completion 或思维链。
why: It turns repeated sampling into an auditable curriculum signal across perception, text reasoning, and visual reasoning, while making the central reuse boundary explicit: answer-level success vectors and images are public, but raw correct and rejected chains of thought, decontamination, and source-level license resolution are not.
inclusion_reason: Releases a reusable curriculum data object in which every problem carries 16 sampled final answers, a 16-bit correctness vector, and a pass rate used for easy-to-hard ordering inside perception, textual-reasoning, and visual-reasoning RLVR stages; it also exposes the construction and verifier scaffold while leaving full reasoning completions outside the release.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-language RL post-training commonly merges perception, text reasoning, and visual reasoning examples or orders all examples by a single notion of difficulty. That treatment can hide a dependency the paper isolates: if the model reads the image incorrectly, more reasoning can elaborate the wrong premise rather than repair it. The practical data question is therefore not only which examples are hard, but which capability should be trained first and what repeated-sampling evidence supports the ordering.

This work also exposes an audit gap in many curriculum claims. Aggregate benchmark gains do not reveal the record used to assign difficulty, the model and budget that produced it, or whether failed attempts remain available. VLM-CapCurriculum makes an answer-level version of that record public, while stopping short of a full rollout-trace release.

视觉语言模型的 RL 后训练通常把感知、文本推理与视觉推理样本混合训练，或用单一“难度”概念排列全部样本。论文指出这种处理会掩盖能力间的依赖：如果模型先读错图像，增加推理往往只会沿错误前提继续展开，而不一定能修复感知错误。因此，数据问题不仅是哪些题更难，还包括应先训练哪种能力，以及什么重复采样证据能够支撑这一顺序。

这项工作也暴露了课程学习常见的审计缺口。汇总 benchmark 提升无法说明难度标签对应的具体记录、生成标签的模型与预算，也无法说明失败尝试是否被保留。VLM-CapCurriculum 公开了答案级记录，但没有达到完整 rollout 轨迹发布的范围。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
VLM-CapCurriculum separates two curriculum axes. The capability curriculum runs visual perception, then textual reasoning, then visual reasoning. The difficulty curriculum samples every released problem 16 times with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct at temperature 1.0, extracts the final answer from each attempt, grades it against the target, and stores the mean correctness as pass_rate; the combined curriculum sorts examples from higher to lower pass rate inside each capability stage.

The reusable object is an eight-field row: index, problem, answer, images, source, 16 predictions, 16 correctness flags, and pass_rate. Across 32,736 rows, the vectors contain 523,776 extracted answer-level attempts and the same number of correctness labels. Incorrect extracted answers remain in those vectors. The corresponding full completions, reasoning text, and rejected chains of thought do not.

Images are retained only where the task is multimodal: Stage 1 perception and Stage 3 visual reasoning reference downloadable image archives, while Stage 2 text reasoning uses an empty image list. The object is therefore suitable for auditing answer-level repeated sampling and curriculum order, but not for inspecting the reasoning that led to each answer.

VLM-CapCurriculum 区分两个课程维度。能力课程依次训练视觉感知、文本推理和视觉推理。难度课程使用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在 temperature 1.0 下对每道已发布题目采样 16 次，从每次尝试中抽取最终答案、与目标答案比对，并把平均正确率记录为 pass_rate；组合课程则在每个能力阶段内部按 pass rate 从高到低排序。

可复用的数据对象是一条八字段记录：index、problem、answer、images、source、16 个 predictions、16 个 correctness 标记以及 pass_rate。32,736 条记录一共包含 523,776 个抽取后的答案级尝试和同量的正确性标签。不正确的抽取答案仍保留在向量中，但相应的完整 completion、推理文本和被拒思维链并未发布。

图像只在确实需要多模态输入的阶段保留：Stage 1 感知与 Stage 3 视觉推理引用可下载图像归档，Stage 2 文本推理的图像列表为空。因此，这一对象适合审计答案级重复采样和课程顺序，不适合检查每个答案背后的推理过程。

title: Method
方法
html:
Stage 1 — perception. The pipeline starts from DOCCI images and fine-grained captions. Qwen2.5-72B converts captions into four-way perception MCQs. A question is retained only in the intersection where both Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-32B answer incorrectly from the image but correctly from the caption. The hosted artifact contains 3,360 rows and references 14,847 downsampled DOCCI images. Captions are construction inputs but are absent from the documented row schema.

Stage 2 — textual reasoning. The release redistributes 13,181 ORZ-Math-13k text problems. These rows use the same answer, repeated-prediction, correctness, and pass-rate fields but no image input.

Stage 3 — visual reasoning. The hosted release has 16,195 rows: Math PUMA 6,696, GeoQA170K 6,499, CLEVR-Math 2,000, and ArxivQA 1,000. The paper's method section also names DocVQA, but the Hugging Face card for the released 16,195-row mixture does not. The card therefore treats the four-source hosted list as the released data object and records DocVQA as an unresolved paper-versus-release lineage discrepancy.

Difficulty records and ordering. Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct produces 16 answers per problem at temperature 1.0. Only extracted final answers, their boolean correctness labels, and their mean are stored. Pass rate is quantized in steps of 1/16 and depends on this model and sampling policy. The two-dimensional schedule first fixes the perception-to-text-to-visual capability order, then sorts higher-pass-rate examples before lower-pass-rate examples within a stage.

RLVR scaffold and verifier. EasyR1 runs GRPO with five on-policy responses per input. The released reward extracts a boxed final answer, uses MathRuler for answer equivalence, checks for the required reasoning-and-boxed-answer syntax, and combines accuracy and format scores with weights 0.9 and 0.1. This is an answer-and-format verifier, not a visual-grounding or process verifier. Released Qwen3 launchers keep the vision encoder open in Stages 1 and 3 and frozen in Stage 2.

Budgets. The paper reports a maximum response length of 2,048 tokens, and Appendix Table 6 lists a maximum prompt length of 2,048. Staged runs use 90, 375, and 465 steps, matching the merged baseline's 930 total steps. The Qwen3 launchers specify 16, 15, and 15 epochs across the three stages. The repository quickstart estimates about 24 GPU-hours on eight H200 GPUs for staged Qwen3-VL-8B reproduction. Seeds and several sampling controls for pass-rate generation, as well as RLVR rollout temperature, are undisclosed.

Stage 1——感知。 流程从 DOCCI 图像及细粒度 caption 开始。Qwen2.5-72B 把 caption 转换成四选一感知题。只有当 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 都在看图时答错、但在读取 caption 时答对，该题才进入二者筛选结果的交集。托管制品包含 3,360 条记录，并引用 14,847 张降采样 DOCCI 图像。Caption 是构造输入，但不在已记录的发布行 schema 中。

Stage 2——文本推理。 发布数据重新分发 13,181 道 ORZ-Math-13k 文本题。这些记录使用相同的目标答案、重复预测、正确性和 pass-rate 字段，但没有图像输入。

Stage 3——视觉推理。 托管发布包含 16,195 条记录：Math PUMA 6,696 条、GeoQA170K 6,499 条、CLEVR-Math 2,000 条、ArxivQA 1,000 条。论文方法部分还列出 DocVQA，但发布的 16,195 条混合数据在 Hugging Face 卡片中没有 DocVQA。因此，本卡以四源托管清单描述实际发布对象，并把 DocVQA 记录为待解决的论文与发布 lineage 差异。

难度记录与排序。 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在 temperature 1.0 下为每道题生成 16 个答案。发布数据只存抽取后的最终答案、逐答案布尔正确性及其均值。Pass rate 以 1/16 为步长离散化，并依赖该模型与采样策略。二维课程先固定感知到文本再到视觉的能力顺序，然后在每个阶段内部让高 pass-rate 样本先于低 pass-rate 样本。

RLVR 框架与验证器。 EasyR1 使用 GRPO，每个输入生成五个 on-policy 响应。发布的 reward 会抽取 boxed final answer，用 MathRuler 判断答案等价性，检查推理段与 boxed answer 所要求的格式，并按 0.9 与 0.1 权重组合准确率和格式分数。这是答案与格式验证器，不是视觉 grounding 或过程验证器。发布的 Qwen3 launcher 在 Stage 1 和 Stage 3 打开 vision encoder，在 Stage 2 冻结它。

预算。 论文报告最大 response length 为 2,048 tokens，附录 Table 6 列出的最大 prompt length 也是 2,048。三个阶段分别训练 90、375、465 steps，与 merged baseline 的 930 个总 steps 相同。Qwen3 launcher 在三个阶段分别指定 16、15、15 epochs。代码仓库 quickstart 估计在八张 H200 上复现分阶段 Qwen3-VL-8B 约需 24 GPU-hours。Pass-rate 生成的随机种子与若干采样控制参数，以及 RLVR rollout temperature，均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The public artifacts substantiate the data contract independently of model scores: all three dataset cards document the same eight logical fields, a single hosted train split, 16 predictions and correctness flags per row, and pass rate as their mean. Their row counts sum to 32,736. Stage-specific image archives are present for perception and visual reasoning, while text reasoning explicitly has no images.

In the paper's Qwen3-VL-8B comparison, staged training reports a visual-math average of 51.10 versus 49.64 for merged training, with mean response length 445 versus 562 on the validation analysis. In the curriculum comparison, capability plus difficulty reports 62.99, versus 58.56 for merged training, 60.53 for capability-only ordering, and 60.36 for difficulty-only ordering. These experiments support the tested scheduling recipe; they do not prove that the released difficulty labels are intrinsic, that individual traces are valid, or that the source mixture is contamination-free.

The paper's motivating diagnosis also uses a different feedback system from training: Claude-4.5-Haiku labels perception errors, and manual review agrees on 33 of 40 sampled judgments. The resulting 86.9% perception-error estimate is therefore a judge-dependent diagnostic, not the programmatic RLVR reward and not ground truth for the released rows.

Evidence for exact reproduction remains partial. The repository provides the construction utilities, reward code, stage launchers, data bindings, models, and hosted datasets, but not the 16 raw sampled completions, sampling seeds, token-level logs, per-attempt latency, or reward/advantage logs.

公开制品在模型分数之外独立支持了数据契约：三个 dataset card 都记录相同的八个逻辑字段、单一托管 train split、每条记录 16 个 prediction 与 correctness 标记，以及由其均值得到的 pass rate。三个阶段的行数合计为 32,736。感知和视觉推理阶段提供相应图像归档，文本推理阶段则明确不含图像。

在论文的 Qwen3-VL-8B 对比中，分阶段训练的视觉数学平均分为 51.10，merged training 为 49.64；验证分析中的平均 response length 分别为 445 和 562。在课程对比中，能力加难度课程报告 62.99，merged training 为 58.56，仅能力排序为 60.53，仅难度排序为 60.36。这些实验支持被测试的调度方案，但不能证明已发布难度标签具有内在性，也不能证明单条轨迹有效或源混合不存在污染。

论文用于提出问题的诊断还采用了与训练不同的反馈系统：Claude-4.5-Haiku 负责标注感知错误，人工复核在 40 个抽样判断中同意 33 个。因此，86.9% 感知错误估计是依赖 judge 的诊断结果，不是程序化 RLVR reward，也不是发布记录的 ground truth。

精确复现所需证据仍不完整。代码仓库提供构造工具、reward 代码、阶段 launcher、数据绑定、模型和托管数据集，但没有 16 次采样的原始 completion、采样种子、token 级日志、逐尝试延迟或 reward/advantage 日志。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is the combination of a capability-ordering claim with a released answer-level difficulty object. Relative to merged post-training, the recipe treats visual perception, textual reasoning, and visual reasoning as distinct stages with an explicit dependency order. Relative to conventional easy-to-hard curricula, it makes capability order a separate axis and composes the two axes rather than reducing all examples to one scalar ranking.

For rollout-data research, the useful distinction is that repeated sampling is not only an evaluation procedure: its extracted outcomes become a persistent per-problem curriculum field. The release preserves both correct and incorrect answer-level candidates, unlike a winner-only selection artifact. It should still be described as an answer-level repeated-sampling release, not as a corpus of reasoning traces, because extraction discards the underlying completions.

Stage 1 also operationalizes a model-relative perception filter: retain questions that two VLMs fail from pixels but answer from captions. This constructs a targeted perception set, but the filter is coupled to the selected Qwen2.5-VL family and to caption quality rather than establishing a universal definition of perceptual difficulty.

这项工作的贡献在于把能力顺序主张与已发布的答案级难度对象结合起来。相较于 merged post-training，方案把视觉感知、文本推理和视觉推理作为不同阶段，并给出明确的依赖顺序。相较于传统 easy-to-hard 课程，它把能力顺序设为独立维度，并组合两个维度，而不是把所有样本压缩成单一标量排名。

对 rollout 数据研究而言，关键差别是重复采样不只用于评估：抽取后的结果会成为每道题持久化的课程字段。发布数据同时保留正确和错误的答案级候选，不是只保留 winner 的选择制品。但它仍应被描述为答案级重复采样发布，而不是推理轨迹语料，因为答案抽取过程丢弃了底层 completion。

Stage 1 还实现了一种依赖模型的感知筛选：保留两个 VLM 看像素时失败、读 caption 时成功的问题。这能构造定向感知集合，但筛选与所选 Qwen2.5-VL 模型家族及 caption 质量绑定，不能视为普适的感知难度定义。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The release boundary is the main audit limitation. Each of the 523,776 stored predictions is an extracted string or option letter, not a raw completion. There are no released reasoning traces, token logprobs, seeds, per-attempt token counts or latency, rollout rewards, advantages, or stable per-rollout identifiers. Incorrect final answers are observable, but the failed reasoning that produced them is not; reward hacking, unsupported reasoning, and answer-extraction errors therefore cannot be inspected.

pass_rate is a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct measurement at temperature 1.0, quantized in increments of 1/16. It can change with the policy, prompt, extraction rule, seed, or unreported sampling controls, so it is not an intrinsic difficulty property. Sorting higher pass rate first also encodes a particular easy-to-hard choice rather than proving that the order is optimal for every backbone.

The verifier grants most credit to final-answer equivalence and a smaller amount to output format. It does not check intermediate reasoning, image grounding, or whether the answer follows from the cited visual evidence. The same MathRuler-based reward is used across all three released Qwen3 stage launchers, including perception tasks; syntactically compliant or fortuitously correct answers can receive reward.

Lineage is incomplete in several ways. The paper lists DocVQA in Stage 3, whereas the hosted 16,195-row dataset lists only Math PUMA, GeoQA170K, CLEVR-Math, and ArxivQA. Stage-1 rows omit the DOCCI captions used to generate them. The hosted artifacts expose only train splits; a deterministic 85/5/10 formatter in the Stage-1 utility is a local construction option, not evidence of released validation and test manifests. No decontamination procedure is disclosed.

Licensing must be audited below the top-level labels. The paper is CC BY 4.0, the code repository is Apache-2.0, and the dataset cards declare Apache-2.0. Yet Stage 1 derives from DOCCI and notes its caption license, Stage 2 redistributes ORZ-Math-13k, and Stage 3 says each image source retains its upstream license. Those source-specific obligations are not replaced by the collection-level license.

Other interpretation risks include correlated errors from using Qwen2.5-72B to generate Stage-1 questions and two Qwen2.5-VL models to filter them, and an inconsistency between broad main-text wording about the vision encoder and the appendix/scripts' open-frozen-open schedule. Benchmark improvements demonstrate outcomes in the reported settings, not completeness or quality of the data release.

发布边界是主要审计限制。523,776 个已存 prediction 中，每一个都是抽取后的字符串或选项字母，不是原始 completion。发布数据没有推理轨迹、token logprob、随机种子、逐尝试 token 数或延迟、rollout reward、advantage，也没有稳定的逐 rollout 标识。错误最终答案可见，但产生它们的失败推理不可见，因此无法检查 reward hacking、缺乏依据的推理或答案抽取错误。

pass_rate 是 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在 temperature 1.0 下的测量值，并以 1/16 为步长离散化。它会随 policy、prompt、抽取规则、种子或未披露的采样控制而改变，不能视为题目的内在难度属性。按较高 pass rate 优先排序也只是特定的 easy-to-hard 选择，不能证明该顺序对所有 backbone 都最优。

验证器的大部分分数来自最终答案等价性，较小部分来自输出格式。它不检查中间推理、图像 grounding，也不判断答案是否确由引用的视觉证据推出。三个已发布 Qwen3 stage launcher 都使用同一 MathRuler-based reward，包括感知任务；格式合规或偶然答对的响应也可能获得奖励。

Lineage 在多个方面不完整。论文在 Stage 3 列出 DocVQA，但托管的 16,195 条数据只列 Math PUMA、GeoQA170K、CLEVR-Math 和 ArxivQA。Stage-1 记录不含生成过程中使用的 DOCCI caption。托管制品只有 train split；Stage-1 工具中的确定性 85/5/10 formatter 是本地构造选项，不能作为已发布 validation/test manifest 的证据。去污染流程未披露。

许可必须在顶层标签以下继续审计。论文为 CC BY 4.0，代码仓库为 Apache-2.0，dataset card 也声明 Apache-2.0。但 Stage 1 派生自 DOCCI 并注明其 caption license，Stage 2 重新分发 ORZ-Math-13k，Stage 3 则说明各图像源保留上游许可。Collection-level license 不能替代这些源特定义务。

其他解释风险包括：Stage 1 用 Qwen2.5-72B 生成题目、再用两个 Qwen2.5-VL 模型筛选，可能保留同家族相关错误；主文关于 vision encoder 的宽泛表述也与附录和脚本中的 open-frozen-open 计划不完全一致。Benchmark 提升只展示所报告设置中的结果，不能证明数据发布完整或质量可靠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data track, this release is useful as a compact answer-level repeated-sampling corpus. Researchers can reconstruct the 16-attempt success distribution for every problem, compare capability strata, study how a fixed sampling budget produces a quantized selection signal, and retain negative final-answer evidence rather than only the selected answer. Because raw completions are absent, it cannot support trace-length, reasoning-pattern, branch, token-cost, latency, or process-error analysis.

For post-training, the three hosted datasets, image archives, EasyR1 launchers, and answer-plus-format reward provide a concrete staged RLVR scaffold. They can be used to compare merged, capability-ordered, difficulty-ordered, and two-dimensional curricula under the reported training budgets. Reusers should keep the repeated-sampling scorer distinct from the five-response on-policy GRPO training group: the former produces offline curriculum metadata, while the latter produces optimization rollouts.

For verifier and curriculum audits, the vectors expose disagreement and model-relative difficulty that a scalar alone would hide. Useful follow-up studies include rescoring the same rows with other policies, calibrating pass rate against held-out outcomes, testing alternative ordering directions or adaptive schedules, and measuring sensitivity to extraction and verifier errors. Such work requires additional sampling metadata for strict replication.

Reuse should remain conditional on per-source licensing, decontamination, and lineage review, especially for Stage-3 images and the DocVQA discrepancy. The artifact is suitable for L4 card-level study because its source, record, verifier, construction path, budget, intended RLVR use, and missing information are identifiable; its unresolved release boundaries do not support promotion to a higher audit state.

对 Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data 方向而言，这一发布适合作为紧凑的答案级重复采样语料。研究者可以重建每道题 16 次尝试的成功分布，比较不同能力层，研究固定采样预算如何产生离散化选择信号，并保留负面最终答案证据，而不只保留被选答案。由于缺少原始 completion，它不能支持轨迹长度、推理模式、搜索分支、token 成本、延迟或过程错误分析。

对后训练而言，三个托管数据集、图像归档、EasyR1 launcher 和答案加格式 reward 构成具体的分阶段 RLVR 框架，可用于在所报告训练预算下比较 merged、能力排序、难度排序及二维课程。复用者必须区分重复采样 scorer 与每组五个 response 的 on-policy GRPO training group：前者生成离线课程元数据，后者生成用于优化的 rollout。

对验证器和课程审计而言，向量能暴露仅看标量时被隐藏的分歧和依赖模型的难度。可开展的后续研究包括：用其他 policy 重评分同一批记录、校准 pass rate 与 held-out outcome 的关系、测试相反排序或自适应 schedule，以及测量答案抽取和验证器错误的影响。严格复现这些研究仍需额外采样元数据。

复用必须以逐源许可、去污染与 lineage 审计为前提，尤其要关注 Stage-3 图像和 DocVQA 差异。该制品适合 L4 card-level 研究，因为其来源、记录、验证器、构造路径、预算、RLVR 用途和缺失信息均可识别；未解决的发布边界不支持升级到更高审计状态。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Count the release as 32,736 train-only rows and 523,776 extracted answer-level attempts; do not describe those attempts as raw completions or chains of thought.
  • Read the three stage datasets as 3,360 perception, 13,181 text-reasoning, and 16,195 visual-reasoning rows; images are retained only for the two multimodal stages.
  • Keep the paper/release mismatch visible: the paper names DocVQA for Stage 3, while the hosted 16,195-row source list contains Math PUMA, GeoQA170K, CLEVR-Math, and ArxivQA.
  • Distinguish the 16-sample offline difficulty budget from the five-response on-policy GRPO group, and treat pass rate as model- and sampling-dependent.
  • Audit upstream licenses, train-only splits, absent decontamination, and missing raw rollout logs before reuse; benchmark gains do not resolve these issues.

• 应把发布规模记为 32,736 条仅含 train split 的记录和 523,776 个抽取后的答案级尝试；不要把这些尝试写成原始 completion 或思维链。
  • 三个阶段分别包含 3,360 条感知、13,181 条文本推理和 16,195 条视觉推理记录；图像只在两个多模态阶段保留。
  • 必须保留论文与发布差异：论文为 Stage 3 列出 DocVQA，但托管的 16,195 条源清单只含 Math PUMA、GeoQA170K、CLEVR-Math 和 ArxivQA。
  • 要区分离线难度计算的 16-sample 预算与 on-policy GRPO 的五 response 训练组，并把 pass rate 视为依赖模型和采样策略的测量值。
  • 复用前需审计上游许可、仅 train split、缺失的去污染与原始 rollout 日志；benchmark 提升不能解决这些问题。

value.html: Stage 1 uses perception-focused four-way MCQs generated from fine-grained DOCCI image captions; Stage 2 redistributes 13,181 ORZ-Math-13k text-math problems; Stage 3 releases 16,195 visual-reasoning problems from Math PUMA (6,696), GeoQA170K (6,499), CLEVR-Math (2,000), and ArxivQA (1,000). The paper also names DocVQA, but the hosted Stage-3 dataset card does not include it in the released mixture.

Every hosted row documents index, problem, answer, images, source, 16 extracted final-answer predictions, 16 boolean correctness values, and scalar pass_rate. Stage-1 and many Stage-3 rows use multiple-choice option letters; Stage-2 uses text-math answers. Raw full completions and chain-of-thought text are not included in the documented dataset schema.

Qwen2.5-72B generates Stage-1 perception questions and answers from captions. Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct generates the 16 difficulty-scoring answers stored per released problem. During RLVR, the current policy of each Qwen or InternVL backbone generates on-policy training responses.

Offline JSONL stage datasets and image archives feed an EasyR1 GRPO pipeline. Capability staging runs perception, then textual reasoning, then visual reasoning; the optional two-dimensional curriculum additionally orders rows easy-to-hard by pass rate within each stage.

The released training reward extracts a boxed final answer, grades it with MathRuler, checks a paired think tags plus \boxed{...} output format, and combines 0.9 answer accuracy with 0.1 format reward. Difficulty records grade each of 16 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct answers against the target and store the boolean vector and its mean. Neither contract verifies the reasoning steps.

A training rollout succeeds when its extracted boxed answer is graded correct; format compliance contributes a smaller scalar bonus. A difficulty sample's terminal label is its answer-level correctness, and the problem's pass rate is the mean of the 16 labels.
Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, InternVL3-8B, and InternVL3.5-8B are trained in staged/merged experiments; Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct is the difficulty-scoring model.
Qwen2.5-72B for Stage-1 caption-to-MCQ generation
Qwen2.5-72B synthesizes perception MCQs; the current VLM policy generates GRPO responses; Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct produces the 16 released difficulty predictions per row.

Difficulty estimation samples 16 answers per problem from Qwen3-VL-8B at temperature 1.0. Capability+difficulty ordering applies descending pass rate within each capability stage. Training GRPO samples a group of five responses per input; other rollout sampling parameters and random seeds are unknown.
16 difficulty-scoring predictions per released row, yielding 523,776 extracted predictions and correctness labels over 32,736 rows; GRPO training group size is five responses per input.
1.0 for difficulty-score generation; RLVR training rollout temperature is unknown.

A Stage-1 QA is retained only when both Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-32B answer it incorrectly from the image but correctly from the caption. Stage 2 curates ORZ-Math-13k. The hosted Stage-3 release mixes four open sources; any additional row-level retention rules are unknown. Difficulty curricula sort by pass rate from easy to hard.

Maximum training response length is 2,048 tokens and Appendix Table 6 lists maximum prompt length 2,048. Staged training reports 90, 375, and 465 steps, while merged training uses 930 total steps. The Qwen3 launchers specify 16, 15, and 15 epochs for stages 1-3. The repository estimates about 24 GPU-hours on 8 H200 GPUs for the Qwen3-VL-8B staged quickstart.

EasyR1 GRPO/RLVR with sequential capability stages, answer-plus-format reward, a mixed vision-encoder schedule (open in stages 1 and 3, frozen in stage 2), and optional within-stage difficulty sorting by pass rate.

The public release contains 3,360 DOCCI-derived perception rows, 13,181 ORZ-Math-13k text rows, and 16,195 visual rows from Math PUMA (6,696), GeoQA170K (6,499), CLEVR-Math (2,000), and ArxivQA (1,000), for 32,736 rows total. The paper additionally names DocVQA, but the hosted visual dataset card does not list DocVQA in the released mixture.

Each hosted dataset documents one train split; no release-level validation or test split is documented. The Stage-1 construction utility can produce deterministic 85/5/10 local splits, but that optional formatter does not make the hosted artifact multi-split.
unknown

items: Released predictions are extracted answer strings or option letters, not raw completions; full correct and incorrect reasoning traces, logprobs, token counts, latency, and seeds cannot be audited.
Incorrect answer-level candidates remain in the 16-element vectors, but the reasoning that produced rejected answers is absent, so the release is not a full rollout-trace corpus.

Pass rate is measured with one Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct policy at temperature 1.0 and is quantized in increments of 1/16; it is model- and sampling-policy-dependent rather than an intrinsic difficulty label.
The answer-and-format verifier checks final-answer equivalence and syntax, not visual grounding or intermediate reasoning validity; reward hacking or plausible unsupported traces can pass.
Stage-1 labels are generated from captions by Qwen2.5-72B and filtered with two Qwen2.5-VL models, so caption errors, generator errors, and correlated family-specific blind spots can survive.
The paper lists DocVQA in the visual data mixture while the hosted 16,195-row dataset card lists only Math PUMA, GeoQA170K, CLEVR-Math, and ArxivQA.
The hosted datasets expose only train splits, and no decontamination protocol is disclosed for overlap with training or evaluation benchmarks.
Top-level Apache-2.0 dataset labels do not replace upstream source-specific image, caption, and redistribution obligations; Stage-3 reuse requires per-source license review.
The paper's main-text statement about enabling the visual encoder in all staged phases is imprecise relative to Appendix Table 8 and the released scripts, which use an open/frozen/open schedule.
The headline 86.9% perception-error estimate depends on Claude-4.5-Haiku judgments; manual validation matched 33 of 40 sampled decisions, so the diagnostic label is not a perfect ground truth.

value.html: OpenReview labels the paper CC BY 4.0, and the code repository is Apache-2.0. The three hosted dataset cards declare Apache-2.0, but Stage 1 notes DOCCI's CC BY 4.0 caption license, Stage 2 redistributes ORZ-Math-13k, and Stage 3 explicitly retains the separate upstream licenses of four image sources. Row-level reuse obligations are therefore not fully resolved by the top-level labels.

DOCCI caption and image -> Qwen2.5-72B perception MCQ -> dual-VLM image-fail/caption-pass intersection -> hosted Stage-1 row; ORZ-Math-13k -> hosted Stage-2 row; four visual corpora -> hosted Stage-3 row. Each hosted problem is sampled 16 times by Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct -> extracted answers -> correctness vector -> mean pass rate. Rows are then used as three sequential EasyR1 GRPO stages, optionally sorted by pass rate within stage.
